quests.name: A Parcel for the Clothes Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Dunhollow to the clothes shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the clothes shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Magic Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the magic shop keeper of Dunhollow and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the magic shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Dunhollow Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Dunhollow Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Dunhollow Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Ghosts
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the ghost near Dunhollow thinned out.
intro: The ghost beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 12 of them close to Dunhollow and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Maple Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Dunhollow has run out of maple logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 24 maple logs and nobody in Dunhollow has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Dunhollow to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the magic shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Barber
quests.summary: Call on the barber of Dunhollow and bring back their answer.

Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The clothes shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.summary: Climb down into Dunhollow Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Dunhollow Sewers.

outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Dunhollow and bring back raw tuna.
intro: The wilds around Dunhollow need a firm hand. Start with 12 zombie outside the walls, then 19 giant spider down in Dunhollow Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 19 raw tuna to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Dunhollow for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the banker, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the food shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the banker.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Dunhollow Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Dunhollow Sewers and tell the clothes shop keeper.
intro: Dunhollow Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 19 of them, then let the clothes shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Dunhollow owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Dunhollow Sewers is clearer than it was. 19 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Velneir
quests.summary: Gather coal for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Velneir.
intro: I have an order from Velneir and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 24 coal, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Dunhollow.
From Dunhollow? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Dunhollow and bring back oak logs.
intro: The wilds around Dunhollow need a firm hand. Start with 12 ghost outside the walls, then 19 rat down in Dunhollow Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 19 oak logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.summary: Gather raw salmon for the food shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Velneir.
intro: I have an order from Velneir and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 19 raw salmon, then take the packed shipment to the food shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Dunhollow.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Dunhollow
quests.summary: Find what rules Dunhollow Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Dunhollow Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the magic shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Dunhollow is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Dunhollow Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Dunhollow for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the general store keeper, fight your way through 29 earth warrior and end The Broodmother.
Bring 14 big bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Dunhollow: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Dunhollow Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Dunhollow and Velneir.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Velneir. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 29 zombie near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the clothes shop keeper underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Dunhollow.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Velneir is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Dunhollow has not had news this good in years.
